integrity: The proof supplies a finite permutation extension, full monodromy group enumeration, coprime lifted cycle lengths and a primitive-matrix argument; exact program is self-contained. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only this five-neighbor Boolean rule, uniformly sampled cyclic output words and one-step fibers; no finite-size exact histogram or optimal exponential convergence constant; historical priority remains provisional.
title: An eight-sheet symmetric-group law for periodic predecessors of a nonlinear cellular automaton
